title: Holiday Light Cruise Plus S'mores Fire Pit Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A festive boat tour of Austin’s decorated shoreline, including 360 Bridge, Little Venice, and Mt. Bonnell. After the cruise, we’ll anchor in a quiet cove for a warm winter hangout around a safe tabletop firepit. Perfect for couples, families, friend groups, and visitors seeking a unique Austin winter experience.

This tour includes publicly visible shoreline homes and decorations only. Holiday lights vary by homeowner and are not guaranteed. This experience is independent and not affiliated with any private holiday event, light installation, marina, or attraction. The firepit is safe and contained, and guests participate at their own discretion. Weather, lake conditions, and visibility may affect the route.
